subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub retire the standalone CLI GitHub Release repair workflow, or must this PR keep or replace the post-publish repair path before merge?
rationale: This changes release recovery policy, and source inspection shows the remaining npm release workflow is not equivalent after npm has already accepted the package.

options.title: Replace repair path before deletion
options.body: Add a tested release-only repair workflow or mode that works after npm publish succeeds, then update `specs/deploy.md` and release workflow tests to that path.

options.title: Keep the existing workflow
options.body: Leave `clawhub-cli-github-release.yml` and its runbook section in place until release owners choose a different recovery model.

options.title: Retire with owner acceptance
options.body: Release/security automation owners may accept the operational risk if they document the manual recovery procedure and reconcile the tests.

recommendation.title: Replace repair path before deletion
recommendation.body: Add a tested release-only repair workflow or mode that works after npm publish succeeds, then update `specs/deploy.md` and release workflow tests to that path.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes the touched workflow directory and deploy runbook to this team.
